notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

boot.failedDescription: The server did not answer. Check your connection, then try again. You are still signed in.

validation.passwordTooWeak: Choose a stronger password — longer, and not a common word or pattern.

errors.locked: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.signInFailed: Sign-in failed. Check your username and password.
errors.totpFailed: That code did not work. Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
errors.keyGenerationFailed: Your keys could not be created on this device. Try again.
errors.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Go back and choose another.
errors.slowDown: Too many attempts from here. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.keysChanged: This account's keys did not match what the server says. Sign in again; if it keeps happening, tell the server's administrator.
errors.signInAgain: The sign-in ended before it finished. Sign in again.
errors.setupExpired: Your first sign-in ran out of time, or your temporary password was replaced. Sign in again with the temporary password you have now.
errors.serverKeyChanged: The server's sign-in key changed while your account was being made. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell the server's administrator.
errors.keyBindingTaken: Your account's keys could not be stored. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell the server's administrator.

login.title: Sign in to Kutup
login.description: Your files and messages are unlocked on this device.
login.totpDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.nameHint: Your username, or your Kutup address.
login.recoveryCodeDescription: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-factor authentication. Each code works once.

newKeys.generatingDescription: This takes a few seconds and happens only on this device.
newKeys.passwordNotice: Kutup never sees your password. If you forget it, only your recovery phrase can get you back in.

recoveryPhrase.title: Your recovery phrase
recoveryPhrase.description: 24 words that can restore your account if you forget your password.
recoveryPhrase.warning: This phrase is shown once. Nobody — not even your server's administrator — can recover your files without it or your password.
recoveryPhrase.fileHeader: Kutup recovery phrase for {{account}}. Keep this private and offline.
recoveryPhrase.saved: I have saved my recovery phrase
recoveryPhrase.confirmDescription: Prove you saved it by entering three of its words.
recoveryPhrase.confirmHint: Type the words at these positions.
recoveryPhrase.mismatch: One or more words do not match. Check your saved phrase.

register.title: Create your Kutup account
register.description: Your keys are created on this device and never leave it unencrypted.
register.usernameHint: How people find you in Chat.
register.closedDescription: This server does not accept new accounts. Ask its administrator for one.
register.settingsUnavailable: The server's registration settings could not be read; it may refuse the account.
register.codeHint: This server admits new accounts with a referral code from its administrators.
register.codeOptionalHint: If someone gave you a code, enter it here.
register.codeInvalid: This referral code cannot be used. Check it, or ask for a new one.
register.codeRateLimited: Too many tries from here. Wait a while and try again.
register.codeCheckFailed: The code could not be checked. Try again.

firstLogin.title: Finish setting up your account
firstLogin.description: An administrator created the account {{name}} for you. Choose your own password to create your encryption keys.

recover.nameHint: Your username, or your Kutup address.
recover.title: Recover your account
recover.description: Use your 24-word recovery phrase to choose a new password.
recover.phraseHint: The 24 words, in order, separated by spaces. Numbering is ignored.
recover.phraseInvalid: That is not a valid recovery phrase — check each word.
recover.signsOutEverywhere: Every device and app signed in to this account will be signed out.
recover.failed: Recovery failed. Check the username and the phrase.
recover.doneDescription: Sign in with your new password. Your files and messages are intact.

authorize.title: Opening {{app}}
authorize.failed: The app could not be opened. Try again from the app.
authorize.invalidDescription: This link asks for an app Kutup does not have.

launcher.title: Welcome, {{name}}
launcher.description: Pick up where you left off.
launcher.drive: Files, notes, documents and whiteboards, end-to-end encrypted.
launcher.office: Your notes, documents, spreadsheets, presentations and whiteboards in one place.
launcher.chat: Private conversations and groups across Kutup servers.
launcher.maps: Lists of places, shared and edited together, end-to-end encrypted.
launcher.photos: Your photos and videos, by when and where they were taken, end-to-end encrypted.
launcher.contacts: Everyone you write to, chat with and share with, in one encrypted address book.
launcher.mail: Your mail, end-to-end encrypted with other Kutup users and encrypted the moment it arrives from anyone else.
launcher.pass: Your passwords in KeePass vaults kept in Drive, usable offline and with KeePassXC.
launcher.calendar: Your events and calendars, encrypted, with times only your server needs to remind you.

account.title: Account
account.description: Who you are on this server, and how much space you use.
account.colourDescription: Your cursor and highlight colour when editing documents with others.
account.colourFailed: The colour could not be saved.

username.title: Username
username.description: Your username is your Kutup address. You can change it: your files, chats, mail and contacts stay with you.

rename.title: Change your username
rename.description: Only your name and address change. People who know you see the new name, and your old address receives mail for a while.
rename.takeBack: One of your earlier names: you can take it back.
rename.checkFailed: The name could not be checked. Try again in a moment.

reason.held: This name is held for its earlier owner.

rename.warning: Your old address, {{address}}, will receive mail for {{receive}} and cannot send. After that it stops receiving, and after {{hold}} someone else can take the name. Update every service that uses the old address now.
rename.windowsFailed: Kutup could not say how long your old address is kept. Try again later.
rename.failed: Your username could not be changed.

errors.tooSoon: You can change your username once every 30 days. You can change it again on {{date}}.
errors.tooSoonNoDate: You can change your username once every 30 days.
errors.tooManyHeld: You hold as many earlier names as an account can while they receive mail. Stop one of them from receiving below, then change your username.
errors.breakGlass: This server's emergency administrator account keeps its name.
errors.setupRequired: Finish setting up your account first.
errors.ownFreedName: This was your name before, and its old encryption keys must be carried over to take it back. That isn't possible yet; it will be soon.
errors.conflict: Your username changed on another device meanwhile. Close this and try again.

names.title: Earlier names
names.description: Names you left are held for you. Each receives mail for a while and cannot send, then is freed for others.
names.dropDescription: Mail to this address bounces from now on. The name stays yours until {{date}}, then anyone can take it.
names.dropWarning: This cannot be undone. You can stop one address every 30 days.
names.failed: Your earlier names could not be loaded.

errors.tooSoon: You can stop one address every 30 days. Next on {{date}}.
errors.tooSoonNoDate: You can stop one address every 30 days.
errors.notHeld: This name is no longer held for you.

security.title: Security
security.description: Protect your sign-in and know how to get back in.
security.twoFactorDescription: Ask for a code from an authenticator app when signing in with a password.
security.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
security.verifyFailed: That code did not work. Enter the current code.
security.disableWarning: Your password alone will then be enough to sign in.
security.disableFailed: Two-factor authentication could not be turned off.
security.passwordDescription: Change the password you sign in with. Your files, mail and chats stay as they are: only the key that opens them is sealed again.
security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices are signed out.
security.wrongCurrentPassword: Your current password is not right.
security.wrongPassword: That is not your Kutup password.
security.passwordChangeFailed: The password could not be changed. Try again.
security.passwordSignsOutOthers: Every other device signed in to your account is signed out. This one stays signed in.

events.title: Security events
events.description: Changes to how you sign in, newest first. If you do not recognise one, change your password and check Devices & sessions.
events.none: Nothing has changed since your account was made.
events.failed: Security events could not be loaded.

kind.recovery: Password reset with the recovery phrase
kind.nameClosed: Mail to {{oldName}} stopped by an administrator
kind.recoveryCodeUsed: Signed in with a recovery code
kind.securityKeyCompromised: Security key “{{oldName}}” may have been copied (no longer used)

security.recoveryDescription: The 24 words shown when your account was created.
security.recoveryNote: Your recovery phrase is the only way to reset a forgotten password. Kutup does not store it and cannot show it again — keep your saved copy somewhere safe and offline.
security.recoveryCodesDescription: One-time codes that sign you in if you lose your authenticator app.
security.codesNone: No recovery codes left. Make new ones so you can still sign in without your authenticator app.
security.renewWarning: Your current recovery codes stop working.
security.renewFailed: New recovery codes could not be made.
security.saveCodesNote: If you lose your authenticator app, each code signs you in once in its place. Keep them somewhere safe. They are not shown again.
security.codesFileHeader: Kutup recovery codes for {{account}}. Each code works once.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Every place your account is signed in. Ending a sign-in there takes effect immediately.
sessions.endDescription: It will need to sign in again. Anything it was uploading stops.
sessions.endFailed: The session could not be ended.
sessions.endOthersDescription_one: {{count}} other sign-in will end. This device stays signed in.
sessions.endOthersDescription_other: {{count}} other sign-ins will end. This device stays signed in.

devices.title: Editing devices
devices.description: Each app that edits documents with others in a browser (Drive, Office, Maps, Pass) and each command-line client is a device of your account, with its own key that signs its edits. Remove one you no longer use.
devices.revokeDescription: {{name}} is taken off your account's device list: its edits are no longer accepted, and its open editing sessions close.
devices.revokeFailed: The device could not be removed.
devices.emptyDescription: A device appears here the first time an app opens a document to edit.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you appear to the people you chat and share files with.
profile.avatarError: That picture could not be used. Try a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
profile.name: Name
profile.visibility: Your name, picture and about are end-to-end encrypted: the server cannot see them. Only people you chat or share folders with see them.
profile.saveFailed: The profile could not be saved.
profile.addressDescription: Give it out so people can reach you; the QR code holds the same address.

devicesSessions.title: Devices & sessions
devicesSessions.description: Everything your account is signed in with: browsers and the command line, the browsers with Chat, and the keys that sign your edits.

chatDevices.title: Chat devices
chatDevices.description: Browsers with Chat set up. Removing one also takes it out of your groups, so it happens in Chat.
chatDevices.none: Chat is not set up in any browser yet.

maps.title: Maps
maps.description: Maps show shared places and live locations in Chat, and where photos were taken. They are off until you turn them on.
maps.offByServer: Maps are turned off on this server.
maps.enableHint: Off by default. Without maps, a shared place shows its coordinates and an “Open in maps app” link.
maps.noticeDirect: Maps load straight from {{provider}}. It sees your IP address and the areas you look at, which for a friend's shared location or a photo's place is roughly where that is.
maps.noticeRelay: Maps load through this Kutup server from {{provider}}. {{provider}} sees only this server; this server sees which areas you look at.
maps.noticeEncrypted: The places themselves (shared places, live locations, photo locations) stay end-to-end encrypted and are drawn on the map in your browser.
maps.relayHint: The provider then sees this server instead of your address.
maps.relayEnforced: This server loads every map for you: providers never see your address.
maps.relayOff: Maps load straight from the provider on this server.
maps.saveFailed: The map settings could not be saved.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: One pool for everything you keep on this server: Drive, Photos, Office, Maps and Chat.
storage.byKindPartial: Some folders could not be read, so this may be incomplete.

level.warningHint: Free up space so uploads, saves and Chat backups keep working.
level.dangerHint: Uploads, saves and Chat backups are refused until you free up space or your administrator gives you more.

cleanup.title: Free up space
cleanup.description: What you could remove, and how much each would free. Nothing is deleted without asking.
cleanup.trashHint_one: {{count}} file waiting to be deleted. It still counts until the trash is emptied.
cleanup.trashHint_other: {{count}} files waiting to be deleted. They still count until the trash is emptied.
cleanup.emptyTrashDescription_one: {{count}} file ({{size}}) will be deleted for good.
cleanup.emptyTrashDescription_other: {{count}} files ({{size}}) will be deleted for good.
cleanup.largeHint: Your files of {{size}} or more, largest first.
cleanup.trashStillCounts: Files in the trash still count until you empty it.
cleanup.versionsHint_one: Kept for {{count}} day, then removed on their own, except those marked Keep forever.
cleanup.versionsHint_other: Kept for {{count}} days, then removed on their own, except those marked Keep forever.
cleanup.versionsHintUnknown: Removed on their own after a while, except those marked Keep forever.
cleanup.chatHint: Clear stored attachments per conversation in Chat; the messages stay.
cleanup.failed: That did not work. Try again.
cleanup.noVersions: You have no earlier versions to delete.
cleanup.newestStays: Each file's newest version always stays: it is the file itself.
cleanup.deleteVersionsDescription_one: {{count}} version older than {{days}} days ({{size}}) will be deleted from your files' version history.
cleanup.deleteVersionsDescription_other: {{count}} versions older than {{days}} days ({{size}}) will be deleted from your files' version history.
cleanup.deleteVersionsKept: This includes versions marked Keep forever. It cannot be undone.
cleanup.deleteAllVersionsDescription_one: {{count}} earlier version ({{size}}) will be deleted from your files' version history.
cleanup.deleteAllVersionsDescription_other: {{count}} earlier versions ({{size}}) will be deleted from your files' version history.

storage.kindsNote: File types come from the names this browser decrypts; the server sees only sizes. Each copy you keep counts, in Chat too.

keys.title: Encryption keys
keys.description: Your email address and the keys that protect mail to and from it. Your account signs them, so people who have verified you in Chat or Drive can trust them too.
keys.addressHint: Kutup users find these keys through your account; anyone else through Web Key Directory.
keys.noAddress: Your account has no email address yet: it comes with your username.
keys.none: No key yet. It is created the next time you sign in.
keys.createFailed: Your key could not be created. It will be tried again the next time you sign in.
keys.notInListHint: The server lists this key, but the key list your account signed doesn't have it. It is never added to your next key list. Contact your administrator.
keys.missing: Your key list names a key the server no longer has right: {{fingerprint}}. Contact your administrator.
keys.notSigned: This key list is not signed by your account. Do not trust these keys and contact your administrator.
keys.downloadFailed: The public key could not be downloaded.
keys.newDescription: New mail to you is encrypted to the new key, and it signs what you send. Your current keys stay, so older mail still opens. Use this when you want to change keys, for example once a year.
keys.newDone: New key created and made primary.
keys.importDescription: An OpenPGP private key for {{address}}, exported from Kutup, Proton or GnuPG (Curve25519, with one user ID for this address).
keys.importPassphraseHint: The passphrase the file is locked with; leave empty if it has none.
keys.importPrimary: Use it for new mail (make it the primary key)
keys.importWrongPassphrase: The passphrase does not open this key file.
keys.importAlreadyThere: This key is already one of your keys.
keys.importNotAKey: This is not a key file Kutup can read.
keys.importNotUsable: This file has no key Kutup can use for {{address}}: it must be a Curve25519 key with one user ID for this address.
keys.exportDescription: Saves this key, locked with a passphrase you choose, to use in another OpenPGP program or to keep as a backup.
keys.exportWarning: Anyone with this file and its passphrase can read your mail. Keep both safe, and never send them by email.
keys.exportFailed: The key could not be exported.
keys.changeFailed: The keys could not be changed. Reload and try again.
keys.compromisedDescription: Do this if someone else may have the key. Nobody encrypts to it any more, and signatures made with it are no longer trusted. It stays only to open your older mail.
keys.deleteForwardingKeyDescription: This key is used for email forwarding. Deleting it ends the forwarding, and the email already forwarded to you with it can no longer be opened.
keys.outdatesForwardings: Existing end-to-end encrypted email forwardings will need to be manually re-enabled.
keys.encryptionOffForwarding: End-to-end encryption is off for {{address}} while it forwards email outside Kutup. Zero-access encryption remains on. It comes back when the last such forwarding ends.

admin.forbidden: Your account cannot open administration pages.

quota.storageHint: One pool for Drive, Photos, Office, Maps and Chat.

users.title: Users
users.description: Accounts on this server. Kutup cannot read their data — only its size.
users.emptyDescription: Create the first account with New user.

newUser.usernameHint: They sign in with it; their address is this name at this server.
newUser.title: New user
newUser.description: The person signs in with a temporary password, then chooses their own; their keys are created on their device.
newUser.tempPasswordHint: Generated for you. Give it to the person privately.
newUser.failed: The user could not be created.
newUser.createdDescription: Give {{name}} this temporary password. It works until their first sign-in.
newUser.handOver: Share it privately — not in the same message as the username. It is not shown again.

user.notFound: This account does not exist, or was deleted.
user.protectedNote: This is the server's break-glass administrator (ADMIN_ACCOUNT). It cannot be disabled, demoted, wiped or deleted from here.
user.enableHint: Let this person sign in again.
user.disableHint: Blocks sign-in and ends every session at once. Their data is kept.
user.enableDescription: {{name}} will be able to sign in again.
user.disableDescription: {{name}} is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until enabled again.
user.promoteHint: Administrators manage users, server settings and federation.
user.demoteHint: Removes access to these administration pages.
user.promoteDescription: {{name}} will be able to manage every account and the server's settings.
user.demoteDescription: {{name}} keeps their account but loses administration access.
user.quotasHint: Uploads beyond the quota are refused; nothing already stored is removed.
user.saveFailed: The change could not be saved.
user.recoveryHint: For people locked out. Kutup cannot reset a password without destroying data it cannot read.
user.twoFactorHint: For someone who lost their authenticator. Their password alone will sign them in.
user.twoFactorDescription: {{name}} will be able to sign in with just their password until they set 2FA up again.
user.rotateHint: This account has not signed in yet; replacing its temporary password loses nothing.
user.yourPassword: Your own password, to confirm it is you
user.adminLocked: Too many attempts with your password. Wait a while and try again.
user.adminSlowDown: Too many attempts from here. Wait a minute, then try again.
user.rotateDescription: The current temporary password for {{name}} stops working.
user.wipeHint: Last resort when both the password and the recovery phrase are lost: deletes all their files and messages and starts the account over.
user.wipeDescription: Every file, folder, message and key of {{name}} is destroyed. The account restarts with a new temporary password.
user.wipeWarning: This cannot be undone. Nobody can recover the data afterwards.
user.deleteHint: Removes the account and everything it owns.
user.deleteDescription: {{name}} and everything it owns are removed from this server.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Public links people reported. The server can't see what a link shows: open it when the reporter included it, then dismiss the report, take the link down, or disable the account that made it (which takes all of its links down).
reports.emptyDescription: Reports anyone makes from a public link's page show up here.
reports.noneResolvedDescription: Reports you dismiss or act on are listed here.
reports.more_one: and {{count}} more report on this link
reports.more_other: and {{count}} more reports on this link
reports.folderLink: Link to a folder or album, made {{date}}
reports.noLink: The reporter did not include the link.
reports.removeDescription: Anyone who opens it is told it was removed. {{name}} keeps the file and can share it again; every open report on this link is closed.
reports.disableDescription: {{name}} is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in, and every public link of theirs stops working, until you enable the account again. Their data is kept.
reports.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.

actions.federationIdentityAdvance: {{admin}} accepted an authenticated identity rotation from {{domain}}
actions.reportDismiss: {{admin}} dismissed a report on a link of {{target}}
actions.shareRemove: {{admin}} took down a public link of {{target}}
actions.mailOutsideSendingUpdate: {{admin}} changed who may send to outside addresses from {{from}} to {{to}}

settings.title: Server settings
settings.description: Defaults and limits for everyone on this server.
settings.registrationHint: Who may create an account on this server. Administrators can always create accounts.
settings.chatHint: Encrypted message and media delivery on this server.
settings.mailboxDaysHint: How long an offline device's messages wait. 0 keeps them until delivered.
settings.mediaDaysHint: How long attachments wait for download. 0 keeps them until delivered.
settings.groupLinkJoinsGroup: Group link joins per server and group (a minute)
settings.groupLinkJoinsGroupHint: Joins and join requests through a link that one server's users may make to one group hosted here.
settings.groupLinkJoinsRelay: Group link joins per server (a minute)
settings.groupLinkJoinsRelayHint: The same across all groups hosted here.

multi.chatMultiMaxRecipientsHint: How many members on this server one group message reaches in one request.
multi.chatMultiMaxMessageBytesHint: What each member gets of one group message, at most.
multi.chatMultiBaseBytesHint: One request may be this large, plus 132 bytes per member.
multi.chatMultiIpBytesPerMin: Group sends per address (bytes a minute)
multi.chatMultiIpBytesPerMinHint: How much one address may send in group messages each minute.
multi.chatMultiOriginRequestsPerMin: Group sends from another server (a minute)
multi.chatMultiOriginRequestsPerMinHint: How many group messages one other server may deliver here each minute, all its users together.
multi.chatMultiOriginBytesPerMin: Group sends from another server (bytes a minute)
multi.chatMultiPerRecipientPerMinHint: How many group messages one member here gets each minute, from every sender together. Past this, senders send that member's copy one by one.
multi.chatMultiPerTokenPerMin: Repeats of one group send (a minute)
multi.chatMultiPerTokenPerMinHint: How often one group send's proof may be used each minute.
multi.chatGroupSendEndorsementsPerDay: Group send proofs per account (a day)
multi.chatGroupSendEndorsementsPerDayHint: Each account fetches one a day to let its groups send to it; this allows retries.
multi.chatGroupEndorsementUploadsPerDay: Group send proofs per member and group (a day)
multi.chatGroupEndorsementUploadsPerDayHint: For groups hosted here: how many proofs one member may share with one group each day.
multi.chatGroupEndorsementPageSizeHint: For groups hosted here: how many members' proofs one read returns, at most 200.

settings.groupAvatarMaxHint: Encrypted group pictures come in four sizes; larger ones are refused.
settings.groupAvatarStorageHint: The current picture and one waiting upload together.
settings.groupAvatarStorageRange: At least twice the largest group picture, and at most 82002.
settings.groupAvatarPendingHint: How long an uploaded picture waits for the group to switch to it.
settings.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.
settings.defaultQuotaHint: What new accounts get. Existing accounts keep theirs; change one on its user page.
settings.passVaultMaxHint: The largest .kdbx file someone can upload into Pass (from KeePassXC or a backup). A vault's own saves are never refused. 1 to 1024.
settings.calendarHint: Limits on what each account keeps in Calendar.

calendarLimits.calendarsPerAccountHint: How many calendars one account may own.
calendarLimits.calendarEventsPerCalendarHint: How many events one calendar may hold.
calendarLimits.calendarSyncBatchHint: How many event changes one request may carry.
calendarLimits.calendarWindowDaysHint: The longest span one events query may ask for.
calendarLimits.calendarEventsPageHint: The most events one page of an events query carries.
calendarLimits.calendarMaxCountHint: The largest COUNT a repeating event may have (Proton's 49).
calendarLimits.calendarRemindersPerEventHint: How many reminders one member sets for one event.
calendarLimits.calendarDefaultRemindersHint: How many default reminders one member keeps for a calendar.
calendarLimits.calendarReminderLatenessSecondsHint: How late a reminder may still be sent; later ones are skipped.
calendarLimits.calendarAlarmTickSecondsHint: How often the server looks for reminders to send.
calendarLimits.calendarAlarmBatchHint: How many due reminders the server takes at once; it takes batches until none is due.
calendarLimits.calendarAlarmBatchPerAccountHint: Of one batch, the most one account's reminders take, so one account never delays everyone else's.
calendarLimits.calendarAlarmSendsHint: How many reminder pushes and emails the server sends at the same time.
calendarLimits.calendarAlarmsPerAccountHint: The most upcoming reminders one account keeps; reminders past it don't fire.
calendarLimits.calendarRecomputeBatchHint: How many events' reminders the server updates at once after someone changes their defaults or time zone.
calendarLimits.calendarPushSubscriptionsPerAccountHint: How many browsers of one account take reminder pushes; a new one past it replaces the longest-held.
calendarLimits.calendarAlarmsPageHint: The most alarms one page of the alarms query carries.

settings.chatLinkingHint: How a new Chat device is linked by one the account already has.

chatLinkingLimits.chatLinkTokenSecondsHint: How long a link token and the new device's link code stay usable.
chatLinkingLimits.chatLinkTokensPerAccountHint: How many link tokens one account may hold unused at once.
chatLinkingLimits.chatProvisionBodyBytesHint: The largest provisioning message relayed to a device being linked, up to 64 KiB.
chatLinkingLimits.devicesPerAccountHint: How many app installations one account may have in all (Chat, Office, Drive, the CLI), 1 to 127.
chatLinkingLimits.deviceListingGraceSecondsHint: How long a newly registered device has to add itself to its account's device list before another device's update drops it.
chatLinkingLimits.chatMaxActiveDevicesHint: How many Chat installations one account may have, 1 to 10.
chatLinkingLimits.chatProvisioningTicketSecondsHint: How long a new device has to open its linking socket after asking for it.
chatLinkingLimits.chatProvisioningSocketsPerAccountHint: How many devices of one account may wait to be linked at once.
chatLinkingLimits.chatDistributionMessageBytesHint: The largest message a new Chat identity sends each kept device.

settings.twoFactorHint: Recovery codes and security keys for accounts with two-factor authentication.

twoFactorLimits.twoFactorRecoveryCodesHint: How many one-time codes are made when someone turns two-factor authentication on or makes new codes.
twoFactorLimits.securityKeysPerAccountHint: How many security keys one account may add.
twoFactorLimits.webauthnCeremonySecondsHint: How long a prompt to touch a security key stays open, when adding one or signing in.

settings.driveHint: How large a file may be, and how videos and audio play while they download.

driveLimits.driveUploadMaxBytesHint: The largest file one upload stores, encrypted.
driveLimits.driveVersionMaxBytesHint: The largest saved version: an editor's save, or a new upload of a file.
driveLimits.driveStreamMaxBytesHint: Larger files download whole before they play. 0 never streams.
driveLimits.driveStreamCacheBlocksHint: Checked 4 MiB blocks a playing file keeps in memory.
driveLimits.driveStreamReadaheadBlocksHint: Blocks fetched ahead of the one playing.
driveLimits.driveStreamMaxConcurrentHint: Files one browser tab plays at once.
driveLimits.driveStreamResponseMaxBytesHint: The most one ranged download answer carries, also across servers.
driveLimits.driveStreamBlobFallbackMaxBytesHint: Where a browser can't stream, files up to this size load whole into memory to play.

federation.title: Federation
federation.description: Which other Kutup servers this one talks to, and how far it trusts them.
federation.identityHint: Give this fingerprint to other servers' operators so they can verify you.
federation.notConfigured: Set FEDERATION_SERVER_NAME and a persistent FEDERATION_SIGNING_KEY to talk to other servers (see the self-hosting guide).
federation.policyHint: Who may exchange messages and shares with this server.
federation.globalHint: Off stops all traffic with other servers, whatever the per-app policy says.
federation.saveFailed: The change could not be saved.
federation.peersHint: Servers this one has met, and the identity it pinned for each.
federation.noPeers: Servers appear here once someone shares or chats with them.
federation.verifyDescription: Ask that server's operator for its fingerprint over a channel you trust (in person, a phone call), then paste it here. It must match exactly.
federation.fingerprintMismatch: This does not match the pinned fingerprint. Do not verify.
federation.repinDescription: The server presented a new identity that was not signed by its old one, so it was quarantined. Re-pin only after its operator confirms the new fingerprint through a channel you trust.
federation.evidenceDescription: Every identity document this server has presented, as recorded here.

maps.title: Maps
maps.description: Which map providers people may choose, and whether map traffic goes through this server. Kutup stores no map data itself.
maps.enabledHint: Off: every map feature is hidden and nothing is ever requested from a map provider.
maps.providersHint: People choose among these. Each person's maps stay off until they turn them on.

providerHint.openfreemap: Free vector maps, no API key.
providerHint.openstreetmap: The OpenStreetMap Foundation's free image tiles, no API key, under its tile usage policy.
providerHint.custom: A tile server you run, e.g. your own OpenFreeMap or OpenStreetMap tile server.

maps.customUrlVector: The style JSON URL, e.g. https://tiles.example.org/styles/liberty
maps.customUrlRaster: A tile template with {z}, {x} and {y}, e.g. https://tiles.example.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png
maps.relayHint: Through the relay, providers see this server rather than people's addresses, and the server sees which areas are viewed.

proxyHint.off: Browsers load maps straight from the provider.
proxyHint.available: On by default for each person; they may load maps directly instead.
proxyHint.enforced: Every map loads through this server. Needed when your own tile server is only reachable from the server.

maps.cacheHint: One cache for everyone; oldest tiles go first. 0 turns it off.
maps.noCacheWarning: Without a cache the relay fetches the same tiles again and again, which breaks OpenStreetMap's tile usage policy at any real volume.
maps.saveFailed: The map settings could not be saved.

mailSending.title: Mail sending
mailSending.description: Who sends mail to outside addresses, and how it goes. One account sending spam can get the server's address blocklisted, and then nobody's mail arrives. Counts only: you never see what was sent.
mailSending.emptyDescription: Accounts that send to outside addresses, or have their own limits, show here.
mailSending.limitsDescription: Outside recipients this account may send to. Leave empty for the server's limits (lower in an account's first week). Mail between Kutup users is never limited.
mailSending.cardHint: What this account sends to outside addresses. Pause it here, or give it its own limits.
mailSending.policyLabel: Who may send to outside addresses
mailSending.policyHint: Mail between Kutup users always goes. A change applies at once, for everyone; the server's MAIL_OUTSIDE_SENDING only gave the first value.

mailGroups.title: Mail groups
mailGroups.description: Distribution lists and shared mailboxes, each with its own storage. The role addresses are always here: give them the people who read them.
mailGroups.emptyDescription: Create a distribution list or a shared mailbox.
mailGroups.deleteShared: The shared mailbox and all its mail are deleted, and its address becomes free. This cannot be undone.
mailGroups.deleteList: The list is deleted and its address becomes free. Members keep the mail they already received.
mailGroups.quotaDescription: The group's mail is counted here, never against its members.
mailGroups.createDescription: An address of this server for a team.
mailGroups.name: Name before the @

kindHint.list: Each member gets the mail in their own inbox and handles it on their own.
kindHint.shared: One mailbox the members read and answer together; once someone reads a message, it is read for everyone. Its key is made now, in this browser.

mailGroups.createFailed: The group could not be created.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: Bugs, ideas and messages people sent from the apps. Forward one to the public tracker after checking it for anything private: who sent it is never included.
feedback.emptyDescription: What people send from the apps' sidebar appears here.
feedback.noneResolvedDescription: Feedback you mark done, dismiss or forward is listed here.
feedback.deleteDescription: It is removed for good. An issue made from it on GitHub stays there.
feedback.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.
feedback.forwardDescription: A prefilled issue opened on {{repository}} in a new tab. Check it for anything private before you submit it, then paste its address here to link the two.
feedback.prepareDescription: Check what the issue will say. It opens on GitHub with this title and text, and you submit it there.
feedback.publicWarning: This creates an issue on {{repository}}. If that repository is public, anyone can read it, including any personal details in this feedback: names, email addresses, file names or anything quoted from a message. Remove them first.
feedback.issueBodyHint: Who sent the feedback is not included. Edit out anything else personal.
feedback.checkedPersonal: I've removed personal details, and this can be public

codes.title: Referral codes
codes.description: Codes that let people sign up when registration needs one. A code is shown once, when you make it.
codes.emptyDescription: Make one to let someone sign up while registration needs a code.
codes.revokeDescription: The code …{{hint}} stops working at once. Accounts already made with it stay.
codes.revokeFailed: The code could not be revoked.
codes.newDescription: Choose how long it works and how many accounts it may create.
codes.noteHint: Who or what the code is for. Only administrators see it.
codes.noteTooLong: A note is at most 200 characters.
codes.usesHint: Each sign-up with the code uses one.
codes.createFailed: The code could not be made.
codes.madeDescription: Copy it now: it is not shown again. Afterwards you see only its last four characters.

rateLimits.title: Rate limits
rateLimits.description: How often each thing may happen before the server refuses more. A change applies at once here and within 30 seconds on every other backend. Each value is between 1 and 100 times its default.

limit.totp_attempts: Wrong two-factor codes before a block
limit.group_link: Join requests through a group link
limit.group_failures_relay: Failed group requests from a server
limit.pass_pin_attempts: Wrong Pass PINs before signing out

about.login_lockout_threshold: Wrong secrets for one account from one client before that pair is locked out.
about.login_lockout_minutes: How long a lockout lasts, and the window of the account ceiling.
about.login_account_ceiling: Sign-in attempts on one account from clients it does not know, all together.
about.login_account_daily_ceiling: The same, per day: the cap on guessing spread over many addresses.
about.login_source_daily_ceiling: One client's share of an account's daily ceiling.
about.totp_attempts: Wrong second-factor codes before a sign-in is blocked.
about.totp_block_minutes: How long a blocked sign-in stays blocked.
about.fork: Sessions handed to an app (every app opened redeems one).
about.register: Sign-ups: scripted account spam on open registration.
about.registration_code_checks: Referral codes checked before signing up, valid or not.
about.registration_code_failures: Referral codes that admitted no one: guessing codes.
about.user_lookup: Looking users up to share with: enumerating accounts.
about.device_registrations: Device registrations: an editing app or the CLI registering itself.
about.account_head_reads: Reads of the account head, its chain and a scope's index.
about.rename_lookups: Another server's renames asked of it (lookups that found nothing kept).
about.feedback: Feedback sent: filling the administrators' inbox.
about.available_hashes: Name checks ("Keep both"): guessing names fast.
about.collab_frame_posts: Collaboration frames sent over HTTP (the CLI).
about.collab_frames_per_second: Collaboration frames one socket sends a second, on average.
about.collab_frame_burst: Collaboration frames one socket may send in a burst.
about.collab_bytes_per_second: Collaboration bytes one socket sends a second, on average.
about.collab_byte_burst: Collaboration bytes one socket may send in a burst.
about.reports: Reports on public links, which need no account.
about.chat_keys_account: Key bundles fetched: draining one-time prekeys.
about.chat_identity_distributions: New Chat identities an account gives its devices.
about.chat_provisioning_relays: Linking messages an account sends to a device being linked.
about.chat_provisioning_sockets: Linking sockets opened from one address by devices waiting to be linked.
about.chat_link_tokens: Link tokens an account asks for, to link a new Chat device.
about.chat_keys_address: The outer wall on key bundles fetched.
about.chat_anonymous_address: The outer wall on sealed-sender deliveries.
about.sealed_capability_bundles: Key bundles fetched with one sealed-sender capability.
about.sealed_capability_minute: Sealed messages sent with one capability.
about.sealed_origin: Sealed messages one peer server delivers, answered or not.
about.media_capability_minute: Sealed attachments sent with one capability.
about.media_origin: Sealed attachments one peer server delivers.
about.link_previews: Link previews fetched (a page and an image each).
about.group_gateway_relay: Requests from one relay server's users together.
about.group_changes_group: Group changes to one group: many members flooding one log.
about.group_link: Join information asked through a group's link.
about.group_failures_relay: Failed group requests from one relay server.
about.group_creates_relay: New groups from one relay server.
about.group_call_account_tokens: Group-call tokens asked by one account.
about.group_call_origin_tokens: Group-call tokens asked by one peer server.
about.mail_images: Remote images fetched through the image proxy.
about.mail_image_bytes: Remote image bytes fetched through the proxy.
about.mail_images_at_once: Remote images one account fetches at once.
about.mail_images_server_at_once: Remote images the server fetches at once, for everyone.
about.forwarding_confirmations: Requests to the public forwarding confirmation page.
about.forwarding_confirmations_sent: Verification code emails one account causes, across its forwardings.
about.forwarding_invites: Verification codes one forwarding sends in a day.
about.forwarding_bounces: Bounces that pause an outside forwarding.
about.forwarding_outside_account: Messages one account's forwardings re-send outside.
about.call_links: Calls opened and joined through a link, which need no account.
about.call_link_polls: Waiting to be let into a meeting, and watching who waits.
about.map_tiles: Map tiles through the map proxy: a runaway client.
about.pass_icons: Site icons answered (a large vault asks for many).
about.pass_icon_fetches: Sites fetched for icons (what the cache answers does not count).
about.pass_pin_attempts: Wrong PINs in a row before the sign-in ends.
about.fed_multi_failures: Forwarded group sends that do not authenticate.
about.rename_peer_fetches: Renames fetched from one peer, whoever asks.
about.account_peer_fetches: Accounts one account asks of one peer by id.
about.rename_announces: Rename announces taken from one peer.
about.admin: Admin API requests: a wall for a script.
about.calendar_writes: Calendar changes: calendars made or changed and event syncs.
about.forwarding_code_minutes: How long a forwarding's verification code lasts.
about.forwarding_code_attempts: Wrong verification codes before the code is void and a new one is needed.
about.forwarding_code_resends: Verification codes one forwarding may send in a minute.
about.forwarding_codes_per_destination: Verification codes one destination address receives in a day, from every account.
about.forwarding_unverified_pending: Forwardings one account may have waiting for their code at once.
about.forwarding_unverified_minutes: How long after its last code an unverified forwarding lapses.

limits.title: Limits
limits.hint: This account's own values of the settings and rate limits that limit one account. Without one, the account gets the server's value. Lowering a value below what the account already uses only stops it from adding more; nothing is removed.

source.account: This account's own; the server's is {{site}}
source.site: The server's, as administrators set it

mailDomains.title: Mail domains
mailDomains.description: Custom domains people on this server send and receive mail at: their owners, their states, and the records this server publishes for them.
mailDomains.notConfigured: Custom domains can't work on this server yet: Stalwart's management key or MAIL_DKIM_KEYS isn't set.
mailDomains.drift: Stalwart's own objects (outside the custom domains) changed on {{date}}. Look into it.
mailDomains.recordsHint: Publish these in this server's own DNS: customers' SPF includes the first, and their DKIM records point to the others. Keep a key published while it is pending or retiring.
mailDomains.deactivateBody: {{domain}} stops at once: its addresses are freed and {{owner}} is told in their inbox.
mailDomains.deactivateWarning: Its name, and every name under it, is blocked until you lift the block.
mailDomains.outOfRange: {{setting}} must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

settings.modeHint: Off stops adding new domains; domains already held keep working.
settings.addressesPerAccount: Addresses per account (every domain, the username's included)
settings.addsPerDay: Domains one account may add in a day
settings.pendingDays: Days an unverified domain is kept
settings.catchAllPerDay: Messages a catch-all takes in a day
settings.graceWarnDays: Days a warned domain keeps working
settings.graceStoppedHours: Hours before a domain whose records are gone stops
settings.checkTimeoutSeconds: Seconds a DNS check may take

overrides.title: Mail domains
overrides.description: This account's limits over the site's; empty keeps the site's.

groupMembership.title: Group membership
groupMembership.description: The Mail groups you belong to. A distribution list's mail arrives in your own inbox; a shared mailbox opens in Mail, where its members read and answer it together.
groupMembership.emptyTitle: You are not in any groups
groupMembership.emptyDescription: An administrator adds you to distribution lists and shared mailboxes.

emailForwarding.title: Email forwarding
emailForwarding.notEncrypted: Forwarded email isn't end-to-end encrypted on its way to you. Nothing is forwarded unless the code sent to you is entered. You can stop it here at any time.
emailForwarding.declined: Forwarding declined. You won't receive email forwarded from {{from}}.
emailForwarding.invalid: This link isn't valid, or the forwarding has already been stopped.
emailForwarding.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
